source:
The workshop compared two settings on the same classroom lamp.
The initial run used the default setting for all trials.

For the lamp sensor, the median delay decreased from 20 ms to 12 ms.
The team did not record a mean delay.

In a separate battery trial, the final voltage stayed stable at 3 volts.
The battery trial measured voltage at the terminals.

The library queue sometimes grew during the afternoon.
Observations covered two weekdays and excluded holidays.

A blue filter doubled the exposure time in the camera trial.
The camera stayed in the same position for both settings.
queries: The lamp sensor's median latency fell to 12 milliseconds.
The final battery voltage was 5 volts.
Rainfall predicted the price of train tickets.
